short: Federal courts · judiciary open data (CJPF), drug named

drugs: rul_all, rul_cocaine, rul_fentanyl, rul_heroin, rul_marijuana, rul_meth, rul_opium, rul_pharma, rul_unnamed

label: Federal judiciary open data (CJPF): people convicted of drug crimes
drugs: cj_other, drug_all, fc_194, fc_195, fc_195bis, fc_196ter, fc_198, federal_drug, narcomenudeo, nmc_475, nmc_476, nmc_477
note: People convicted of drug crimes in first-instance federal sentences, by article of the law, by state of the justice center and year of the sentence, 2016 to 2026 (2026 in part). New (accusatory) system only; early years thin while publication ramped up. Matches the October memo (2,558 people in 2021, 1,593 in 2024).

label: INEGI federal prison census (drug crimes of people held, by legal status)
drugs: pr_drug_all, pr_drug_sentenced, pr_drug_unsentenced, pr_fd_all, pr_fd_sentenced, pr_fd_unsentenced, pr_nm_all, pr_nm_sentenced, pr_nm_unsentenced
note: Drug crimes of the people held in federal prisons at the close of each year, without sentence or sentenced, 2019 to 2024. The census has columns for mandatory and justified pretrial detention but leaves them empty (everyone without sentence is not identified).

label: INEGI federal prosecutor census (people detained, all federal agencies)

drugs: drug_all, fd_other, fd_possession, fd_production, fd_supply, fd_trade, fd_trafficking, fd_transport, fd_unspecified, federal_drug, narcomenudeo, nm_other, nm_possession_for_sale, nm_simple_possession, nm_supply, nm_trade, nm_unspecified

drugs: drug_all, fd_other, fd_possession, fd_production, fd_supply, fd_trade, fd_trafficking, fd_transport, fd_unspecified, federal_drug, narcomenudeo, nm_other, nm_possession_for_sale, nm_simple_possession, nm_supply, nm_trade, nm_unspecified

short: All federal agencies · Informe annex (Esfuerzo Nacional)
label: Informe de Gobierno annex, Esfuerzo Nacional table (people detained)
note: People handed over by all federal authorities for drug crimes and related crimes (firearms, organized crime, precursors and others), from FGR data (6th Informe, page 691). 2000 to 2024; 2024 is January to June. Never add it to agency lines.

label: Informe de Gobierno annex, SEDENA table (people detained)
note: People detained in the army's fight against drug trafficking: drug crimes and the firearms law (6th Informe, page 692). 1995 to 2024; 2024 is January to June.

label: Informe de Gobierno annex, SEMAR table (people detained)
note: People detained by the navy, Informe de Gobierno annex (6th Informe, page 692), 1995 to 2024. The definition printed with the table was not checked.

label: SEDENA yearly results sheets (people detained)
note: People detained in operations against drug trafficking, 2014 to September 2026 (2026 partial). Equal or close to the Informe to 2018, higher from 2019 (10,391 against 9,019 in 2019). No crime or place.

label: INEGI state police census (drug crimes in handovers)
drugs: drug_all, fd_other, fd_possession, fd_production, fd_supply, fd_trade, fd_trafficking, fd_transport, fd_unspecified, federal_drug, narcomenudeo, nm_other, nm_possession_for_sale, nm_simple_possession, nm_supply, nm_trade, nm_unspecified
note: Drug crimes of the people state police handed to a prosecutor, by type of crime. Counts crimes, not people. Up to 2019 the census counted police interventions, from 2020 handovers (a break in 2020). 2025 national totals only. Municipal tables exist from 2020 (not used here).

label: INEGI state prison census (drug crimes of people held, by legal status)
drugs: pr_drug_all, pr_drug_justificada, pr_drug_oficiosa, pr_drug_other, pr_drug_sentenced, pr_drug_unsentenced, pr_fd_all, pr_fd_justificada, pr_fd_oficiosa, pr_fd_other, pr_fd_sentenced, pr_fd_unsentenced, pr_nm_all, pr_nm_justificada, pr_nm_oficiosa, pr_nm_other, pr_nm_sentenced, pr_nm_unsentenced
note: Drug crimes of the people held in state prisons at the close of each year, by legal status: without sentence (from 2022 split into mandatory pretrial detention, prisión preventiva oficiosa, and justified, justificada) or sentenced. Counts crimes of people held. 2020 to 2024. Narcomenudeo and federal drug crimes; in 2024 state and federal prisons held 19,258 narcomenudeo crimes, the figure of the October memo.
